question: Should OpenClaw permanently bundle and own this Twilio RCS channel, or should RCS ship as an externally maintained code plugin using the existing plugin surface?
rationale: The implementation is technically substantial, but the repository vision explicitly favors externally maintained optional plugins and only maintainers can accept the long-term core configuration, credential, security, support, and release commitment.

options.title: External RCS code plugin
options.body: Move the RCS implementation to an external plugin package and submit only a small, independently justified core API change if a missing generic seam is proven.

options.title: Sponsor bundled ownership
options.body: Accept the permanent bundled channel surface, then require SMS upgrade safety, exact-head dependency approval, and approved-sender live proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until a maintainer records a product decision in the canonical feature issue.

recommendation.title: External RCS code plugin
recommendation.body: Move the RCS implementation to an external plugin package and submit only a small, independently justified core API change if a missing generic seam is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Twilio SMS channel is the closest product and architecture precedent for deciding whether the carrier-adjacent RCS capability belongs in the bundled distribution.
